changes_only: DFII10 and DGS10 impulses are arithmetic percentage-point changes over the declared business-day lookback.
DTWEXBGS impulse is the log change over the declared business-day lookback.
Breakeven proxy is DGS10 minus DFII10; its impulse is the arithmetic percentage-point change over the declared lookback.
Each continuous impulse is normalized by its trailing 252-observation mean and population standard deviation, using only macro values already available after the one-gold-bar causal lag.
real_yield_change score is minus the normalized DFII10 impulse; broad_usd_change score is minus the normalized DTWEXBGS impulse; breakeven_change score is plus the normalized breakeven impulse.

real_yield_usd_agreement is eligible only when the raw lagged real-yield and broad-dollar impulses have the same sign. Score sign is negative of that common sign; score magnitude is the smaller absolute z-score of the two impulses. The same frozen absolute-z entry thresholds apply.
State scoring uses all eligible non-null signal events before trade non-overlap. A 126-day fold is scorable with at least 10 eligible events.

Trading then applies one-active-position non-overlap; signal t enters next XAUUSD daily open and exits after the frozen 5, 20, or 60 completed holding bars; trades crossing a 126-day dependence-fold boundary are excluded.
